blockers.detail: The Sprint 16 and 17 mesh generators take a request-local donor bind-pose capture as their only game-sourced input, so the original Ape and Dire Ape bodies cannot be authored before that capture exists. The offline pre-census already proves the installed library has no primate unit type and no RendFeature consumer, so both bodies must be original geometry on a non-primate rig. Both creatures are withheld, so nothing player-visible depends on the provisional Owlbear donor.
